AssimilatedAdventurer.interpretation: Assimilated Adventurer from reference 1: helmeted humanoid, splayed split chest with internal teeth, two arms and two walking legs. Peelflap is the displayed individual name.

PrimitiveSummoner.interpretation: Primitive Summoner: two large separate rectangular flesh jaws and four high angular support legs. Upper and lower jaws are independently rigged; no spherical spider abdomen.

ParasiteExisting.interpretation: Unmodified project Parasite_Root_Aggressive geometry and vertex colors for before/after comparison.

ParasiteAdapted.interpretation: Adaptation of the actual existing Parasite_Root_Aggressive. Original head, eyes, hands, legs, tendrils, triangle topology and source pivots retained; torso and arms subtly broadened, red folds added behind the head.

AdaptedViscera.interpretation: Adapted Viscera: thick pale-over-red nautilus-like shell, recessed blue-grey mouth, eight long forward-projecting segmented arms with ventral teeth, six separate support legs. Each arm has three bones.

unit: One intended Roblox stud; scale not verified in Studio
rig: Custom rigid-segment NPC skeletons; not Roblox R15
scope: Three new reference models plus an adaptation of the existing Parasite. ParasiteExisting is only a comparison baseline. No new Crux model is included. Dredge remains approved and unchanged.
previews: Rendered from the actual exported source geometry, no paintovers
